_: 律の特別な衣装の固有モーション（docs/ritsu-special-ideas.md）。pipeline/ritsu_motion.py が読む。text は動画の指示（英語）。rare はたまにしか出ない動き

yukihana.name: swing
yukihana.text: She lifts the tall staff up with a small flourish, swings it in a wide graceful arc, and at the end of the swing many small glowing ice crystals burst from the staff's crystal and sparkle in the air, she smiles proudly, then the sparkles fade away and she brings the staff back down and returns exactly to the starting pose.

yukihana.name: bloom
yukihana.text: She taps the base of the tall staff lightly down twice, its crystal lights up, a large delicate snowflake made of ice grows in the air beside her, she looks at it happily, touches it with the staff so it scatters into sparkles that fade away, and she returns exactly to the starting pose.

yukihana.name: rabbit
yukihana.text: She lifts the small white rabbit up in front of her face with her free arm and they look at each other, the rabbit wiggles its ears and she giggles with her eyes closed, then she lowers the rabbit back into her arm and returns exactly to the starting pose.

yukihana.name: breath
yukihana.text: She holds up one hand and softly blows on her palm, a stream of tiny glittering snowflakes drifts away from her hand and melts in the air, she watches it with a calm gentle smile, then lowers her hand and returns exactly to the starting pose.

yukihana.name: return
yukihana.ja: 杖の結晶が飛んで戻る
yukihana.text: The clear ice crystal on top of her staff detaches and shoots straight up into the air while she keeps holding the one staff, it bursts into hundreds of glittering ice shards, the shards spiral back down and reform into the crystal on top of the staff, she gives a cool small smile and returns exactly to the starting pose.

yukihana.name: freeze
yukihana.text: She raises the tall staff and everything stops: glittering snowflakes appear frozen in mid-air around her, perfectly still. She looks around calmly, reaches out and taps one single floating snowflake with her finger, and it sets off a chain reaction in which all the snowflakes burst one after another into sparkles that fade and returns exactly to the starting pose.

yukihana.name: mirror
yukihana.text: A tall thin oval sheet of clear ice rises up beside her, on her left side. Her reflection in the ice waves at her first while she herself stays still. She blinks in surprise, leans over and touches the ice with one finger, and it cracks and shatters into sparkles that fade and returns exactly to the starting pose.

yukihana.name: bunnies
yukihana.text: She taps the tall staff down once, several small white rabbits made of snow pop up one by one from the air around her feet and line up neatly in a row, they all salute together, she gives a small pleased nod, and they all melt into sparkles that fade and returns exactly to the starting pose.

yukihana.name: sneeze
yukihana.text: The small white rabbit's nose twitches and it does a tiny sneeze, a little puff of snow bursts out and lands all over her face and hair, she blinks in surprise with wide eyes, then laughs and shakes the snow off with a small shake of her head, the snow disappears and she returns exactly to the starting pose.

yukihana.name: snowball
yukihana.text: A little snowball drops onto her head with a puff of snow, she looks surprised, then laughs happily, and the snow is gone and returns exactly to the starting pose.

hoshiyomi.name: tip
hoshiyomi.text: The camera is completely locked and never zooms: she and the scale stay exactly the same small size and position in the lower part of the frame, with lots of empty background above. She keeps wearing the same tall star hat, exactly unchanged. The slim golden balance scale floating beside her keeps exactly the same size and stays exactly in place the whole time. She lifts the brim of her hat a little with one finger, looks at the viewer with a confident smile and one eye winking, holds it for a moment, then lowers the brim and returns exactly to the starting pose.

hoshiyomi.name: weigh
hoshiyomi.text: She keeps wearing the same tall star hat, exactly unchanged. The slim golden balance scale floating beside her keeps exactly the same size and stays exactly in place the whole time. She flicks one finger and a small glowing star drops onto one pan of the scale, that pan dips and the other rises while the post stays in place, she nods with a calm smile, the star fades and the pans level again and returns exactly to the starting pose.

hoshiyomi.name: stars
hoshiyomi.text: She keeps wearing the same tall star hat, exactly unchanged. The slim golden balance scale floating beside her keeps exactly the same size and stays exactly in place the whole time. She raises one hand to the height of her head, her arm keeping its normal short length, and traces a shape in the air with her fingertip, a small constellation of glowing gold stars connected by thin lines appears above her, she smiles at it, it fades away, she lowers her hand and returns exactly to the starting pose.

hoshiyomi.name: gavel
hoshiyomi.text: The camera is completely locked and never zooms: she and the scale stay exactly the same small size and position in the lower part of the frame, with lots of empty background above. She keeps wearing the same tall star hat, exactly unchanged. The slim golden balance scale floating beside her keeps exactly the same size and stays exactly in place the whole time. A dark wooden judge's gavel with gold bands appears in her hand, she raises it and strikes the air once with a stern cute look, a thin ring of golden light spreads out from the strike and quickly fades, she smiles and the gavel disappears and returns exactly to the starting pose.

hoshiyomi.name: sphere
hoshiyomi.text: She keeps wearing the same tall star hat, exactly unchanged. The slim golden balance scale floating beside her keeps exactly the same size and stays exactly in place the whole time. A golden armillary sphere of interlocking rings with little planets appears above her and spins faster and faster, the planets leaving thin glowing trails, she raises a hand with a confident smile and it stops at once, then it fades away, she lowers her hand and returns exactly to the starting pose.

hoshiyomi.name: foxhat
hoshiyomi.text: She keeps wearing the same tall star hat, exactly unchanged. The slim golden balance scale floating beside her keeps exactly the same size and stays exactly in place the whole time. A little fox made of glowing gold star lines pops out from the top of her hat while she keeps wearing it, it runs in a playful circle in the air above her, she follows it with her eyes and laughs, and it dives back into the top of her hat and returns exactly to the starting pose.

hoshiyomi.name: cosmos
hoshiyomi.text: She keeps wearing the same tall star hat, exactly unchanged. The slim golden balance scale floating beside her keeps exactly the same size and stays exactly in place the whole time. She opens the dark cape with one arm and the inside of the cape is a real deep night sky with slowly moving galaxies. She reaches her other arm into it up to the elbow and pulls out a tiny glowing planet, shows it with a smile, tosses it back in, and closes the cape and returns exactly to the starting pose.

hoshiyomi.name: hourglass
hoshiyomi.text: The camera is completely locked and never zooms: she and the scale stay exactly the same small size and position in the lower part of the frame, with lots of empty background above. She keeps wearing the same tall star hat, exactly unchanged. The slim golden balance scale floating beside her keeps exactly the same size and stays exactly in place the whole time. A golden hourglass floats down on her left side, not covering her face, she flips it over with one finger, the glowing sand flows upward instead of down and small sparkles rise around it, she watches with a knowing smile, and the hourglass fades away and returns exactly to the starting pose.

hoshiyomi.name: hatdown
hoshiyomi.text: The camera is completely locked and never zooms: she and the scale stay exactly the same small size and position in the lower part of the frame, with lots of empty background above. She keeps wearing the same tall star hat, exactly unchanged. The slim golden balance scale floating beside her keeps exactly the same size and stays exactly in place the whole time. The hat slowly slides down over her eyes and covers the top of her face, she waves her hands in a flustered way, pushes the hat back up, and gives an embarrassed laugh and returns exactly to the starting pose.

hoshiyomi.name: bite
hoshiyomi.text: The camera is completely locked and never zooms: she and the scale stay exactly the same small size and position in the lower part of the frame, with lots of empty background above. She keeps wearing the same tall star hat, exactly unchanged. The slim golden balance scale floating beside her keeps exactly the same size and stays exactly in place the whole time. She pulls in a thin gold thread and a tiny glowing crescent moon comes floating to her, she takes one small bite out of it with a happy face, the bitten moon looks angry with a tiny frown and flies away out of view, she gasps with an embarrassed laugh and returns exactly to the starting pose.

nocturne.name: orbit
nocturne.text: The six floating books stay in their places at the start and the end. The books keep exactly the same colors and never glow, with no light or aura on them. She wears no hat and nothing is added to her outfit. She raises the silver key like a conductor's baton and circles it in the air, her head and eyes following it, and the six books start to circle around her in a wide ring, faster and faster, she spins the key with a delighted smile, then lowers it, the books slow down and settle back into their exact places and returns exactly to the starting pose.

nocturne.name: read
nocturne.text: The six floating books around her stay in place at the start and the end. The open book on her left floats over to her, she reads it with interest and smiles, then it floats back to its exact place and returns exactly to the starting pose.

nocturne.name: shh
nocturne.text: The six floating books stay in their places at the start and the end. The books keep exactly the same colors and never glow, with no light or aura on them. She wears no hat and nothing is added to her outfit. She has exactly two arms. She raises her empty free hand and clearly puts one finger to her lips in a quiet shh gesture, tilts her head and winks, holds it for a moment, then lowers that hand and returns exactly to the starting pose.

nocturne.name: twirl
nocturne.text: The six floating books stay in their places at the start and the end. The books keep exactly the same colors and never glow, with no light or aura on them. She wears no hat and nothing is added to her outfit. She spins the silver key around one finger by its ring in two quick circles and catches it neatly with a small proud smile and returns exactly to the starting pose.

nocturne.name: door
nocturne.text: The six floating books stay in their places at the start and the end. The books keep exactly the same colors and never glow, with no light or aura on them. She wears no hat and nothing is added to her outfit. She tosses the silver key forward and it disappears through a little wooden door that opens in the air. A moment later another little wooden door opens above her, the key drops out of it and she catches it without looking, with a cool small smile, and both doors fade and returns exactly to the starting pose.

nocturne.name: portal
nocturne.text: The six floating books stay in their places at the start and the end. The books keep exactly the same colors and never glow, with no light or aura on them. She wears no hat and nothing is added to her outfit. No new books appear. She pushes the silver key into the open book on her left and it comes out of the open book on her right, floating back to her. She catches it with a quiet amused smile and returns exactly to the starting pose.

nocturne.name: domino
nocturne.text: The six floating books stay in their places at the start and the end. The books keep exactly the same colors and never glow, with no light or aura on them. She wears no hat and nothing is added to her outfit. Many more plain brown books appear standing in a long curving line in the air around her, the first one tips and they fall one after another like dominoes in a fast sweep around her, she watches with her head following them and nods with a small smile, the extra books fade away and returns exactly to the starting pose.

nocturne.name: ink
nocturne.text: The six floating books stay in their places at the start and the end. The books keep exactly the same colors and never glow, with no light or aura on them. She wears no hat and nothing is added to her outfit. Thin dark ink lines rise from the open book on her right and draw the shape of a small dark bird in the air, the ink bird flies a loop around her while she follows it with her eyes and dives back into the book, she smiles quietly and returns exactly to the starting pose.

nocturne.name: chomp
nocturne.ja: 本にかぷっと挟まれる
nocturne.text: The six floating books around her stay in place at the start and the end. The open book on her left floats up to her face, she leans in to read it, and it playfully snaps shut on the tip of her nose, she flinches with wide eyes, it opens and floats back to its place, she laughs and returns exactly to the starting pose.

nocturne.name: tower
nocturne.text: The six floating books stay in their places at the start and the end. She wears no hat. Books drop from above one after another and stack up on top of her head into a tall wobbling tower, she freezes with wide eyes trying to balance it, the tower tips and the books float away out of view, she lets out a relieved laugh and returns exactly to the starting pose.

hakama.name: twirl
hakama.text: She twirls the open paper umbrella on her shoulder, it spins around, a few pink cherry petals fly off its edge and drift away, she looks up with a happy smile, the umbrella slows and stops and returns exactly to the starting pose. She stays seated on the same branch; the branch and the blossoms on it stay exactly still in place.

hakama.name: wave
hakama.text: She tilts the umbrella back and waves her free hand at the viewer with a bright smile and closed happy eyes, a few cherry petals drift past, she lowers her hand and tilts the umbrella back and returns exactly to the starting pose. She stays seated on the same branch; the branch and the blossoms on it stay exactly still in place.

hakama.name: petalize
hakama.text: She tosses the open paper umbrella straight up into the air, it dissolves into a whirling burst of thousands of pink cherry petals that swirl above her, then the petals rush down in a spiral into her open hand and reform into the umbrella, she catches it with a bright confident smile and returns exactly to the starting pose. She stays seated on the same branch; the branch stays exactly still in place.

hakama.name: magic
hakama.text: She closes the paper umbrella, taps it with one finger, and opens it with a flick: many small round pale olive songbirds burst out from under it and fly up and away with a shower of petals, she watches them go with a delighted smile and returns exactly to the starting pose. She stays seated on the same branch; the branch stays exactly still in place.

hakama.name: split
hakama.text: A swirling whirlwind of pink cherry petals gathers in front of her. She closes the umbrella and sweeps it once in one sharp graceful stroke, a bright line appears and the whirlwind splits cleanly in two and scatters, she gives a calm cool smile and opens the umbrella again and returns exactly to the starting pose. She stays seated on the same branch; the branch stays exactly still in place.

hakama.name: bloom
hakama.text: She snaps her fingers and a huge burst of cherry blossoms blooms all around her in an instant, filling the air with pink, then at the next moment all the blossoms scatter at once in a great shower of petals that drifts away and fades, she laughs with her eyes closed and returns exactly to the starting pose. She stays seated on the same branch; the branch stays exactly still in place.

hakama.name: gust
hakama.ja: 傘が風でひっくり返る
hakama.text: A sudden gust of wind turns the paper umbrella inside out, she gasps with wide eyes and flustered blush while petals fly everywhere, she quickly pops the umbrella back into its shape and lets out an embarrassed laugh and returns exactly to the starting pose. She stays seated on the same branch; the branch and the blossoms on it stay exactly still in place.

hakama.name: crack
hakama.text: The branch under her creaks and she freezes with wide eyes and turns pale, she grabs the umbrella with both hands and for a moment floats gently up into the air hanging from it, then she drifts softly back down, the branch holds, she lets out a relieved laugh and returns exactly to the starting pose. The branch keeps its shape and position.

diva.name: heart
diva.text: She brings both hands beside her cheek and forms a small heart shape with her fingers, a tiny glowing pink heart floats up from it and pops into sparkles, she smiles brightly, then her hand returns to waving and returns exactly to the starting pose.

diva.name: point
diva.text: She stays exactly the same small size in exactly the same place, the camera does not zoom in. She points a finger forward and closes one eye in a playful wink, a little sparkling star pops at her fingertip and fades, then her hand returns to waving and returns exactly to the starting pose.

diva.name: sing
diva.text: She closes her eyes and sings with her mouth open, one hand lightly touching her headset microphone, small glowing music notes float up and fade, she opens her eyes and smiles, then her hand returns to waving and returns exactly to the starting pose.

diva.name: boomerang
diva.ja: ティアラのブーメラン
diva.text: She takes the jeweled tiara off her head and throws it spinning away into the distance like a boomerang, it curves around in a wide glittering arc and comes flying back, and without looking she tilts her head and it lands perfectly on her head with a sparkle, she winks and her hand returns to waving and returns exactly to the starting pose.

diva.name: change
diva.text: She snaps her fingers and a burst of light wraps around her, for a moment she stands in a shining silver and blue version of the same long dress, she strikes a small pose with a big smile, snaps her fingers again and another burst of light returns her to the raspberry dress, her hand returns to waving and returns exactly to the starting pose.

diva.name: dancers
diva.text: Four glowing silhouettes of dancers made of soft pink light appear behind her, two on each side, and together with her they strike a sharp stylish arm pose in perfect sync, she points up with a big smile, the silhouettes burst into sparkles and fade, her hand returns to waving and returns exactly to the starting pose.

diva.name: resonate
diva.text: She sings a long note with eyes closed, her jewels glow one after another and a pillar of pink light rises into the sky with spreading rings, it fades, she smiles, her hand returns to waving and returns exactly to the starting pose.

diva.name: tiara
diva.text: The jeweled tiara slips down over her eyes, she flinches in surprise and pushes it back up with one hand, she blushes and gives an embarrassed laugh with her eyes closed, then her hand returns to waving and returns exactly to the starting pose.

diva.name: popper
diva.text: A little party popper goes off beside her head and colorful paper streamers land on her hair, she blinks in surprise with wide eyes, then laughs with her eyes closed, the streamers fade away, her hand returns to waving and returns exactly to the starting pose.

rock.name: guitar
rock.ja: ケースから取り出して一音
rock.text: She stays sitting on the black amplifier with one knee raised, in exactly the same place at the same small size, the camera does not zoom. Her right hand reaches back over her shoulder to the black case behind her and pulls out a red V-shaped electric guitar: a flat body like a wide letter V with two pointed wings, one big black zigzag lightning bolt painted across it, a long straight narrow neck with frets, a headstock with six tuning pegs, no logo, no letters. It stays the same shape and size the whole time. She holds it resting on her raised knee with both hands the whole time, strums once with a big grin while a few small red sparks pop above her. Then she raises the guitar upright, with the neck pointing straight up, and lowers it straight down into the black case behind her shoulder until it is completely hidden inside the case. The guitar never goes behind or under the amplifier and never lies flat. The guitar never flies and never leaves her hands. Then she returns exactly to the starting pose, sitting with one forearm on her raised knee, gentle smile.

rock.name: nod
rock.ja: 目を閉じてリズムに乗る
rock.text: She stays sitting on the black amplifier with one knee raised, in exactly the same place at the same small size, the camera does not zoom. She closes her eyes and nods her head in rhythm with a small happy smile, her high ponytail and bow bounce, her dangling boot taps in time, small red music notes float up and fade. Then she returns exactly to the starting pose, sitting with one forearm on her raised knee, gentle smile.

rock.name: pick
rock.ja: ピックをはじいてキャッチ
rock.text: She stays sitting on the black amplifier with one knee raised, in exactly the same place at the same small size, the camera does not zoom. She flicks a small red guitar pick up from her thumb, it spins high into the air above her with a little glint, she catches it with the same hand and gives a small confident wink, the pick disappears into her palm. Her legs, boots and the amplifier do not move at all. Then she returns exactly to the starting pose, sitting with one forearm on her raised knee, gentle smile.

rock.name: bolt
rock.text: She stays sitting on the black amplifier with one knee raised, in exactly the same place at the same small size, the camera does not zoom. She raises one arm high and points one finger straight up, far above her head and to her left. A thin bright red lightning bolt strikes down from above onto that fingertip with a few tiny sparks well away from her face. Her face stays completely clean and fully visible, no glow on her face. She looks up at her fingertip with a smug grin, the sparks fade and she lowers her arm. Then she returns exactly to the starting pose, sitting with one forearm on her raised knee, gentle smile. All effects are flat solid colors with crisp hard edges: NO soft glow, NO halo, NO blur and NO light spilling onto the background; the green right next to every effect stays perfectly pure green. Effects use only red and white, never yellow or orange.

rock.name: amp
rock.ja: アンプをたたくと音の輪
rock.text: She stays sitting on the black amplifier with one knee raised, in exactly the same place at the same small size, the camera does not zoom. She pats the top of the amplifier twice with her free hand. Thin delicate rings of soft red light, like ripples, spread out from the amplifier and fade before reaching the edges of the frame. Her ponytail and ribbon sway backward for a moment and she laughs with her eyes closed. The amplifier does not change. Then she returns exactly to the starting pose, sitting with one forearm on her raised knee, gentle smile. All effects are flat solid colors with crisp hard edges: NO soft glow, NO halo, NO blur and NO light spilling onto the background; the green right next to every effect stays perfectly pure green. Effects use only red and white, never yellow or orange.

rock.name: sticker
rock.text: She stays sitting on the black amplifier with one knee raised, in exactly the same place at the same small size, the camera does not zoom. A small red star sticker appears between her fingers, she turns and presses it onto the black guitar case behind her, pats it proudly and nods, the sticker sparkles and fades away, and she turns back. Then she returns exactly to the starting pose, sitting with one forearm on her raised knee, gentle smile.

rock.name: cocoa
rock.text: She stays sitting on the black amplifier with one knee raised, in exactly the same place at the same small size, the camera does not zoom. She takes a small plain can of cocoa with no letters from her jacket pocket, takes a sip with both eyes closed, sighs happily with a small puff of warm breath, and the can goes back into the pocket. Then she returns exactly to the starting pose, sitting with one forearm on her raised knee, gentle smile.

rock.name: neon
rock.text: She stays sitting on the black amplifier with one knee raised, in exactly the same place at the same small size, the camera does not zoom. She snaps her fingers beside her head and a big flat solid red lightning-bolt shape with a crisp hard edge and a thin white center line switches on in the air above her and to her left, flickers twice, she jerks her thumb toward it with a cocky grin, and it fades out with one last flicker. No letters. The lightning-bolt shape has NO soft glow, NO halo and NO light spilling onto the background: the green right next to its edge stays perfectly pure green.

rock.name: feedback
rock.ja: ハウリングでびっくり
rock.text: She stays sitting on the black amplifier with one knee raised, in exactly the same place at the same small size, the camera does not zoom. Red jagged sound waves burst suddenly from the amplifier under her, she jumps a little in surprise with wide eyes and covers both ears with her hands, her ponytail stands straight up, then the waves stop, her hair settles, she lowers her hands and blushes with an embarrassed laugh. Then she returns exactly to the starting pose, sitting with one forearm on her raised knee, gentle smile.

rock.name: cat
rock.text: She stays sitting on the black amplifier with one knee raised, in exactly the same place at the same small size, the camera does not zoom. A small round black cat jumps up onto the amplifier beside her and rubs against her arm, her eyes light up in delight, she gently strokes its head with one hand, the cat gives one slow blink and hops down out of sight behind the amplifier, she waves after it. Then she returns exactly to the starting pose, sitting with one forearm on her raised knee, gentle smile.
